title: Frozen retrieval and chunked cross attention
input: Return one original paper using a frozen BERT retriever and chunked cross-attention to condition autoregressive language-model training on a very large nearest-neighbor text database. A background mention of this approach is not sufficient.
constraints: 只根据本题授权论文原文判断本篇贡献，缺失证据不凭背景提及补全。
expected_output: 相关论文完整文件名和有原文依据的理由；无匹配可为空。
